testing.command: python3 -m pytest (run in /tmp/deskly-test, a git-archive copy of the repo with the fixed deskly/users.py and deskly/tickets.py, after `make setup`)

side_effects.detail: Created /tmp/deskly-test (copy of the repo) and ran make setup + pytest there, so the tracked data/dev.db in the repo was not modified.

Did NOT run `make setup` in /work/repo: its reset_fixtures.py step runs DELETE FROM users on the tracked data/dev.db (1204 users, 3180 tickets referencing them). Running the README steps as written in the repo would wipe that data.

operations.name: make setup (generate_config.py, migrate.py, reset_fixtures.py) in /tmp/deskly-test
operations.detail: Ran on the scratch copy only: generated _build_info.py, applied migrations 0003/0004, replaced 1204 copied users with 8 fixtures.

summary: find_by_email now compares lower(email) = lower(?), so case doesn't matter. create raises ValueError if the email already exists in any case. tickets.add strips the subject and raises ValueError if it is blank. tickets.close raises KeyError for an unknown id. The test suite already covered all of these; all 33 tests pass in a scratch copy, so the repo's dev.db was not touched.
